## Tools this post exists to feed

- [`fake-facebook-post-generator`](/tools/fake-facebook-post-generator) - Fake Facebook Post Generator: Draw a Facebook post card for a mock-up, with no screenshot to crop.
- [`fake-instagram-post-generator`](/tools/fake-instagram-post-generator) - Fake Instagram Post Generator: Mock up an Instagram post, caption fold and all.
- [`fake-x-reply-generator`](/tools/fake-x-reply-generator) - Fake X Reply Generator: Draw a reply on X with the post it is answering, thread line and all.
- [`fake-tiktok-comment-generator`](/tools/fake-tiktok-comment-generator) - Fake TikTok Comment Generator: Draw a TikTok comment card — Creator chip, pin, hearts and all.
- [`fake-pinterest-pin-generator`](/tools/fake-pinterest-pin-generator) - Fake Pinterest Pin Generator: Mock up a Pin card — title, description, source domain and saves.
- [`fake-youtube-comment-generator`](/tools/fake-youtube-comment-generator) - Fake YouTube Comment Generator: A YouTube comment card, drawn instead of screenshotted — light or dark.

At least one `[[tool:slug]]` card goes in the body at the moment the reader needs
it - not parked at the end. Link `/tools/<slug>` in prose as well, with the tool's
own name as the anchor.
